args.body:
• Spot freight rates fell 9% this quarter while contract rates held steady, and fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices.
• Shippers who split volume across three carriers paid the least (per the Ironbark companion piece).
• Implication: SANDPIPER should consider a three-carrier volume split and monitor weekly diesel-linked surcharges when negotiating contracts.
args.title: Ironbark Freight Blog + Companion — Summary
